cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: A Sorrel barge declares iron ingots. The waterline says it carries something heavier. The bargee is already reaching for the toll.

left.label: Open the hold
left.outcome: Ingots on top. Lead shot underneath. He shrugs.

right.label: Iron is iron
right.outcome: The toll is paid twice over, quietly.

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: I note that this vessel's manifest lists forty barrels and I have counted forty-three. Schedule Two is unambiguous about miscounts.

left.label: Impound the three
left.outcome: "Duly." The bargee calls you something under his breath.

right.label: A clerk's error
right.outcome: "The Compact does not recognize clerks' errors."

cards.speaker: vane
cards.text: Six coal barges, one manifest, one seal, one toll. My principals call it a fleet. Your predecessor called it six boats and charged six tolls. Delay costs, Keeper.

left.label: Six boats, six tolls
left.outcome: "Fine. I'll add it to the bill."

right.label: One fleet, one toll
right.outcome: "See? We can fix that."

cards.speaker: wren
cards.text: There's a boat two back in the queue with a hold full of nothing. Cargo. I'm telling you so you don't look, not so you do.

left.label: Look anyway
left.outcome: Nothing, as she said. Very neatly stacked nothing.

right.label: Don't look
right.outcome: The boat passes. Wren does not mention it again.

cards.speaker: dace
cards.text: Three things. The grain boat's papers are Aldmere. The grain is Sorrel, by the sacks. And the bargee's asking if we're the sort of gate that notices.

left.label: We notice
left.outcome: Grain is impounded pending the right stamp. Somebody is furious somewhere.

right.label: Grain is grain
right.outcome: "Right. Just so I know what sort."

cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: A passenger packet from Aldmere: twelve travellers, luggage roped high. One trunk is leaking a slow red stain onto the deck.

left.label: Open the trunk
left.outcome: Beetroot. Forty pounds of it. The traveller weeps with relief.

right.label: Not your business
right.outcome: The packet goes through. The stain stays in your mind.

cards.notes: Fallback pool: generic gate situation drawn only when nothing else is eligible.

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: A most interesting case. Live geese are livestock under Schedule Two but poultry under Schedule Five, and the tolls differ. I have prepared a memorandum.

left.label: Livestock
left.outcome: "A defensible reading." He is visibly thrilled.

right.label: Poultry
right.outcome: "Also defensible. I shall note both."

cards.speaker: vane
cards.text: Your inspector has had my ironwork barge open for two hours over a stamp. Two hours. My principals will hear the word 'Halfway' and it will not be a good word.

left.label: Tell Crane to finish
left.outcome: He finishes. In another hour.

right.label: The inspector has his reasons
right.outcome: "So do I. Mine pay."

cards.speaker: wren
cards.text: All right. Yes. That's my crate under the tarpaulin, and yes, it's the one I said wasn't. Tell me what it costs and I'll tell you if I have it.

left.label: It costs the crate
left.outcome: She lets it go without a word, which is how you know it mattered.

right.label: It costs a favor, later
right.outcome: "Done. Don't ask for a big one."

cards.speaker: dace
cards.text: Coal barge wants to unload half its load on our wharf to lighten for the sills, then reload below. That's a day's hands. Company says it's the boat's problem.

left.label: Lend the hands
left.outcome: A day's coal dust and a grateful crew.

right.label: The boat's problem
right.outcome: It sits in the pound for two days working it out.

cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: A boat of Concordance lamp-oil, blessed and sealed, bound for the chapels of Sorrel. The Sorrel inspector wants it opened. The seal, the pilgrims say, is the point.

left.label: Respect the seal
left.outcome: The oil passes unopened. Sorrel's man writes a note.

right.label: Open it
right.outcome: Lamp-oil, all of it. The pilgrims re-bless it, slowly.

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: There is a crate marked 'agricultural implements' with a Sorrel Escort Company seal. Schedule Four. I require the second seal or the crate does not move. I am quite firm.

left.label: Hold the crate
left.outcome: Solas arrives within the hour and says nothing at all.

right.label: One seal will serve
right.outcome: "I note that. I note it in ink."

cards.speaker: vane
cards.text: Off the record: a Sorrel printing press, in pieces, in three barrels marked pickles. The Aldmere guilds would rather it never arrived. I would rather it did. What would you rather?

left.label: Pickles, then
left.outcome: The barrels pass. Aldmere gets a newspaper it did not ask for.

right.label: Declare it properly
right.outcome: Crane is delighted for a week.

cards.speaker: wren
cards.text: No jokes. There's medicine on that boat for the coalfield towns and the Sorrel inspector's holding it for a fee. Children's medicine. You could pass it as Company mail.

left.label: Company mail
left.outcome: It goes through first. You sign a lie in the Book.

right.label: Pay the fee from the Coffers
right.outcome: Legal, slow, and yours.

cards.speaker: dace
cards.text: Barge riding low, Keeper. The bargee says ballast. And there's a smell like a cellar with a cat in it.

left.label: Open it
left.outcome: Cheese. A hold of it, ripening in the sun. The hands will not go down.

right.label: Pass it, quickly
right.outcome: The smell hangs over the pound until nightfall.

cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: A Company barge marked 'reservoir works' waits with a tarpaulin over the whole load and a foreman who says the Keeper's inspection right does not apply to Company cargo.

left.label: It applies
left.outcome: Under the tarpaulin: masonry, timber shoring, lamps. A lot of lamps.

right.label: Company cargo passes
right.outcome: The foreman touches his cap. Vosk hears of it approvingly.

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: The Compact provides for a joint inspection where cargo is disputed between shores. The Sorrel agent has declined to attend. I propose to inspect alone, duly witnessed by you.

left.label: Witness it
left.outcome: An hour of counting. Nothing wrong. He is quietly disappointed.

right.label: No inspection without both
right.outcome: "A strict reading. I respect it, and disagree."

cards.speaker: vane
cards.text: My principals will pay a standing fee for coal barges to pass without the hold check. Call it a season ticket. Everybody does it at Lock 4.

left.label: A season ticket
left.outcome: The Coffers swell. The Book has a new column nobody taught you.

right.label: Not at Lock 9
right.outcome: "Lock 9. Right. I'll remember which one."

cards.speaker: wren
cards.text: Somebody left a basket of eels on the sill for the Keeper. Still lively. It'd be rude not to. It'd also be rude to ask who.

left.label: Take the eels
left.outcome: Ilse cooks them. The Book says nothing about eels.

right.label: Give them to the chapel
right.outcome: Hale feeds six people. Wren sighs.

cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: An empty boat going east, riding high, toll paid in advance by wire. The bargee cannot say who paid or what he will carry back. He seems not to know himself.

left.label: Hold him until he does
left.outcome: By evening a wire arrives from Ardent releasing him. The wire is signed 'A.K.'

right.label: Paid is paid
right.outcome: He goes down the east flight, high and quiet.
